subject: Re: Request for Registration Fee Refund — ICCBDA 2027
body:
[HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED]

Dear Mr. Brown,

Thank you for your email regarding ICCBDA 2027. We understand that you are requesting a full refund of the registration fee and asking how long the process would take.

A formal refund policy and a refund processing timeline are not currently available. Your request requires review by the conference secretariat, and we cannot confirm refund eligibility, a full refund, or any processing time at this stage. The payment status stated in your email cannot be confirmed from the email alone.

Please contact the conference secretariat at iccbda2027@example.org or refer to the official conference announcement for further assistance.

Sincerely,
Conference Secretariat
review_reason: Refund request requires human review because no formal refund policy or refund processing timeline is provided, and payment status cannot be confirmed from the email.
